versions.changelog: Add invoice risk gates for individual sellers offering equipment, zero or masked tax, line tax-rate arithmetic mismatches, and invoice-versus-line tax total inconsistencies. Risky invoices are blocked before confirmation and all reasons are returned to the uploader.
Use OpenClaw-compatible single-line runtime metadata and exclude the Codex-only default prompt from the ClawHub artifact.
Declare file and shell permissions explicitly, scope access to the selected project, and package the generated .env.example and .gitignore sources reliably.
Initial release: scaffold a Codex-powered Feishu invoice bot with buyer validation, automatic expense categorization, approval reasons, confirmation cards, dry-run safety, and duplicate protection.
